evidence: The films were grown in a hot-wall horizontal flow-type ALD reactor.12 TiI4 (Strem Chemicals Inc.) of 99.99% purity was evaporated from a silica boat kept at 115 °C in the flow of the carrier gas. O2 (AGA, 99.999%) was led into the reaction zone through needle and solenoid valves. The partial pressure of O2 was set at about 30 Pa in the reactor. This pressure was about 4 times higher than the H2O-H2O2 pressure used earlier for growing TiO2 films from TiI4.19 N2 (AGA, 99.999%) was used as the carrier and purging gas. The total pressure in the ALD reactor was 250 Pa, approximately.
